otherReferences.paragraph: runtime/probe.c#snapshot checks the frame and debug synchronization state and returns bottom-to-top entries. Its internal API is pinned to the source revision in runtime/revision.txt. The generated evaluator synchronizes the stack before invoking instruction instrumentation; this is the basis for reading it from the callback, not permission to inspect an arbitrary running frame.
